baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَّقَٰمِعُ (ق م ع) qualified by مِنْ حَدِيدٍ (ح د د).
baseline_models.mechanism: The plural instrument noun activates striking, subdual, humiliation, checking, and repulsion, while the material phrase supplies iron's resistant solidity.

activation_trace.role: Contributes striking, subdual, humiliation, checking, and repulsion as the implements' coupled action profile.
Contributes iron as a resistant solid metal, giving the coercive action durable material force.

changed_reading.before: The phrase merely inventories unspecified iron objects of punishment.
changed_reading.after: It names purpose-built iron implements whose blow subdues and drives the target back, not merely injures.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَدِيدٍ permits limit and prevention branches as well as the metal branch, and مَقَٰمِعُ supplies active repulsion.
baseline_models.mechanism: Iron doubles as material hardness and an unyielding no-crossing limit; the maqami' actively police that limit by checking and repelling.

activation_trace.role: Contributes a distinguishing boundary or terminal limit and turns the iron into spatial enforcement.
Contributes prevention, exclusion, and confinement as the boundary's operative force.
Contributes the act of checking and driving back that makes the limit dynamically enforced.

changed_reading.before: Iron names only the implements' hard material.
changed_reading.after: Iron also marks an enforced terminal boundary, with the maqami' functioning as its barrier-policing instruments.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root ق م ع includes the instrument used to pour into a vessel, while حَدِيدٍ supplies its material.
baseline_models.mechanism: The plural instrument form can carry a secondary image of iron funnels, chutes, or channeling tools rather than only blunt strikers.

activation_trace.role: Contributes the funnel as a pouring tool and opens a channeling-apparatus reading.
Contributes iron construction to the possible pouring or channeling apparatus.

changed_reading.before: Maqami' is exhausted by the image of blunt clubs.
changed_reading.after: A secondary focus-only branch permits iron pouring or channeling tools, pending contextual activation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ق م ع inventory includes a protruding head or extremity, joined here to iron.
baseline_models.mechanism: A projecting head, knob, or terminal mass gives the implement a concrete headed geometry suitable for a heavy iron striker.

activation_trace.role: Contributes a protruding head or terminal projection as the implement's physical geometry.
Contributes the heavy resistant metal from which the headed projection is made.

changed_reading.before: The implements have no specified shape beyond being iron.
changed_reading.after: They can be visualized as headed or knobbed iron strikers with a concentrated terminal mass.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding verdict of humiliation without any restoring honorer selects the abasement component of ق م ع; the implements enact a status judgment through bodily subdual and repulsion.

activation_trace.role: Contributes humiliation together with striking and repulsion, allowing the weapon to enact abasement.
Contributes humiliation through contempt and supplies the social condition that the focus implements materialize.
Contributes honor as the explicitly unavailable opposite, sharpening the implements' degrading function.

structural_cues: 22:18 places humiliation and the absence of an honorer immediately before the 22:19-22 punishment sequence.
The focus's لَهُم assigns the implements within the same punishment scene rather than presenting a detached object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical humiliation, denied honor, and a ق م ع branch coupling abasement with repulsion; I infer a transition from status verdict to embodied mechanism. A live alternative is that the implements cause injury without carrying the social force of humiliation.

changed_reading.before: The iron implements physically overpower their targets.
changed_reading.after: Their physical checking is also the concrete enactment of humiliation: every blow makes the denied honor bodily and spatial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit top-down pouring of a heated medium and its melting effect turn the focus-only funnel branch into a possible component of a directed thermal process: an iron tool that channels, presses, or keeps bodies under the flow.

activation_trace.role: Contributes the funnel or pouring tool as the focus-side apparatus image.
Contributes iron solidity and heat-resistant construction to the possible apparatus.
Contributes literal pouring and supplies the process that makes the funnel branch operational.
Contributes the upper spatial origin and gives the process a downward axis.
Contributes the bodily target at the head, coupling the directed apparatus to its recipient.
Contributes heated water and supplies the thermal medium being directed.
Contributes melting by heat as the directed process's bodily result.

structural_cues: 22:19-20 immediately precede the focus, and the passive pouring establishes a process before the instrument is named.
The nearby مِنْ فَوْقِ and focus مِنْ حَدِيدٍ phrases align source and material relations without proving that the maqami' are the pouring vessels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a funnel branch, an explicit pour from above, iron, and melting; I supply the arrow that places the maqami' inside one delivery-and-restraint system. The live alternative is a sequence of independent punishments in which ordinary maces have no role in pouring.

changed_reading.before: The funnel branch was an unmotivated focus-only possibility.
changed_reading.after: The local pour-and-melt sequence makes an iron channeling or pressing component live alongside the blunt-mace reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of a protruding head meets the immediately preceding location above human heads, yielding a head-to-head geometry for downward-deployed, headed iron strikers.

activation_trace.role: Contributes a protruding head or terminal knob as the implement's literal shape.
Contributes iron mass and resistance to the headed striker.
Contributes the above-to-below orientation in which the headed implements can operate.
Contributes the recipients' heads as the matching bodily endpoint of the geometry.

structural_cues: The plural heads in 22:19 are only two words before the thermal medium and one ayah before the plural maqami'.
The focus is a short nominal clause, so contextual placement carries much of the implement's orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a protruding-head branch and a directly adjacent above-the-head target relation; I infer a concrete object-body alignment. The alternative is that the protruding-head branch is an unrelated nominal extension and contributes no shape.

changed_reading.before: The iron implements are generic clubs with no contextual orientation.
changed_reading.after: They become headed iron strikers imagined on a downward axis over the recipients' own heads.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attempted outward crossing triggers repulsion and return: the maqami' become the actuator of a closed feedback loop rather than intermittent instruments of pain.

activation_trace.role: Contributes checking, repelling, and striking as the force that can reverse attempted motion.
Contributes the terminal boundary at which outward motion is stopped.
Contributes active prevention and confinement to the boundary mechanism.
Contributes movement to the outside as the attempted action that activates the mechanism.
Contributes return after departure as the mechanism's repeated result.

structural_cues: The focus stands directly between the bodily effects in 22:19-20 and the attempted-exit clause in 22:22.
كُلَّمَا and the passive أُعِيدُوا encode recurrence: every attempted exit terminates in return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted exit, repeated return, a repulsion branch, and a preventing boundary branch; I infer that the maqami' implement the directional reversal. A live alternative is that an unnamed force returns them while the iron implements serve only as punishment.

changed_reading.before: The implements deliver repeated blows inside a punishment scene.
changed_reading.after: They police the exit threshold: each outward attempt is mechanically converted into inward return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Whole-surah access language creates an ethical-spatial reversal: barring a shared sacred route and wrongfully expelling people are answered by a hard limit that checks, repels, and prevents the blockers' own passage.

activation_trace.role: Contributes the marked boundary that distinguishes permitted passage from a terminal limit.
Contributes coercive checking and repulsion as the reversal's enforcing action.
Contributes turning others away and blocking access, the human action later mirrored back as repulsion.
Contributes prohibition and protected inviolability, sharpening the surah's concern with legitimate limits.
Contributes deviation from the straight boundary and makes the threatened punishment spatially legible.
Contributes wrongful outward expulsion as the social counterpart to attempted passage and forced return.
Contributes protective repulsion, distinguishing legitimate defense from obstructive coercion.

structural_cues: 22:25 pairs a space made equal for resident and visitor with people who bar its path and a threat of painful punishment.
22:40 pairs wrongful expulsion with protective دفع, producing a whole-surah polarity between abusive obstruction and defensive repulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obstruction, sacred limits, deviation, expulsion, and protective repulsion; I infer a reversal in which the focus instruments turn abusive boundary-making back on its agents. The alternative is that these later access scenes are ethically related but do not specify the mechanism at 22:21.

changed_reading.before: The iron limit is only local architecture preventing escape.
changed_reading.after: It also reads as a counter-boundary: those associated with denying passage meet coercive passage-denial as punishment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a fly and an animal's head-toss are form-distant from the ordinary instrument reading of مَقَٰمِعُ. It remains packet-anchored because ق م ع B003 explicitly joins a blue fly to an animal's attempt to fend it off, while 22:73 repeats the fly and the ذ ب ب inventory supplies both fly and repulsion. Downstream prose should label it a distant branch echo about futile warding, never translate maqami' as flies.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَّقَٰمِعُ retains the ق م ع branch of a blue fly that makes an animal move its head to drive it away.

activation_trace.role: Contributes the blue fly and the animal's head motion to fend it off, anchoring an insect-repulsion echo in the focus root.
Contributes the literal fly whose smallness exposes the invoked powers' inability.
Contributes driving off and protection, activating the focus branch's futile warding motion.

changed_reading.before: The maqami' are only external iron forces striking passive bodies.
changed_reading.after: A distant echo makes the victims' recoil resemble an animal vainly tossing off a fly, while the tiny warded force is grimly inverted into inescapable iron.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the mourning and abstention-from-adornment branch is distant from حَدِيد as metal. It remains anchored in ح د د B007 and is activated by the immediate move from iron in 22:21 to adornment, gold, and fine clothing in 22:23. Downstream prose should present it only as an anti-regalia contrast, not as the lexical meaning of حديد.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حَدِيدٍ carries a remote ح د د branch of mourning through relinquished adornment.

activation_trace.role: Contributes mourning through abstention from adornment and opens a punitive counter-regalia image.
Contributes adornment as the immediate positive counterpart against which iron reads as anti-adornment.
Contributes gold as the contrasting prestigious metal.
Contributes clothing as protective adornment, opposing the punitive iron apparatus.
Contributes fine silk and completes the contrast between honored attire and iron counter-regalia.

changed_reading.before: Iron merely differs materially from the gold named two ayat later.
changed_reading.after: Iron can carry a contained anti-adornment resonance: punitive counter-regalia opposed to gold adornment and silk clothing.

strongest_changes: The adjacent humiliation verdict and forced-return clause recast the iron implements as mechanisms that enact abasement and police attempted escape.
The pour-and-melt sequence activates the ق م ع funnel branch, preserving a thermal channeling or pressing apparatus beside the blunt-striker reading.
Whole-surah obstruction and expulsion language turns the hard limit into an ethical reversal of denied access.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet supported a tight local mechanical circuit of pouring, headed impact, prevention, and return while also exposing distant but resolvable fly-repulsion and counter-adornment echoes that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: It remains uncertain whether the funnel branch contributes actual instrument polysemy in مَقَٰمِعُ or only imagery activated by adjacent pouring.
The text does not explicitly state that the iron implements cause the return in 22:22; that causal arrow is abductive.
The access-reversal model may be a whole-surah ethical analogy rather than a direct specification of the focus mechanism.
The fly and counter-adornment readings are deliberately exploratory and should not alter the base translation.
